refnamediv.refpurpose: Function to install an in-language function into a SilikoEngine

refsection.title: Description
refsection.para: The SilikoEngineInstallFunction installs the function implementation new_function into object with the in-language name function_name. If the engine is passed to SilikoEvaluate the function can be called by the name function_name, and the function can be retrieved by function_name with SilikoEngineCallFunction and SilikoEngineFetchFunction.

refsection.title: Return Values
refsection.para: SilikoEngineInstallFunction returns true if the installation succeeded, false otherwise.
